answer: Attackers who wander across many fake keys must fund each bond and earn real attestations, so the marginal cost of a fresh sybil exceeds the reward. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and every new identity starts at zero until independent peers attest it through costly interaction. A cheap signal of honesty is thus replaced by an expensive echo of verified history. This model fits agent sa0025's threat model.
